abstract: USTR is commencing a public consultation process in advance of the 2027 annual joint review meeting of the Agreement between the United States of America, the United Mexican States, and Canada (USMCA or Agreement). As directed by Congress, USTR is seeking public comments on the operation of the Agreement and providing notice of a public hearing.
action: Request for comments and notice of public hearing.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: January 12, 2027, at 11:59 p.m. EST: Deadline for submitting written comments and requests to appear at the hearing. The request to appear must include a summary of testimony.
title: Request for Public Comments and Notice of Public Hearing Relating to the Operation of the Agreement Between the United States of America, the United Mexican States, and Canada
